data.action: 跪坐忏悔室木格窗旁，指尖贴着窗扉，含泪向画面外的老师倾诉。
data.description: 深夜静谧的圣堂忏悔室内，未花隔着木格窗跪坐，眼角泛着泪光，指尖轻轻贴在窗扉上低语——「老师……大家都说我是罪人……但只要老师还愿意相信我、摸摸我的头，我就永远都有勇气去面对一切……」
data.nsfwProse: She wears her sleeveless gold-embroidered white Tea Party ballgown draped with a soft white silk shawl, white evening gloves, and white tights.
data.promptProse: Kneeling quietly inside a hushed Trinity Cathedral confessional booth late at night, Mika wears her sleeveless gold-embroidered white Tea Party gown, silk shawl, and long white evening gloves. Pressing her gloved fingertips softly against the carved wooden lattice partition, she whispers earnestly toward the listener beyond the screen as glistening tears shine at her eyes in warm flickering candlelight and deep curtain shadows.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 忏悔室里的真心话
data.animaCaption: Kneeling inside the dimly lit cathedral confessional booth in her sleeveless gold-embroidered white gown, shawl, and evening gloves, Mika presses her fingertips against the wooden lattice with glistening tears. Warm candlelight and soft curtain shadows cross the partition.
